top_signals.title: Treasuries Rise as Traders React to Democrat Lead in First Votes
top_signals.summary: Treasuries rallied ahead of the Treasury’s quarterly issuance plans, with traders reacting to the first vote counts from the midterm elections which favored the Democrats.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India’s Middle Class Spending Boom Comes With Growing Debt Bill
top_signals.summary: When 25-year-old restaurant worker Navjot Singh wanted an iPhone he couldn’t afford on his monthly salary of 50,000 Indian rupees ($521), taking out a small loan made the purchase possible. A PlayStation and television set followed, along with loans for a wine and spirits course and a trip home.

top_signals.summary: Follow live coverage of the 2026 US midterm elections, including key congressional races, crypto-backed candidates and what the results could mean for digital asset regulation.
